physics_configuration.report: scripts/platform_report.py --id <platform id> writes docs/validation/platforms/<id>.json with the GPU name, compute capability, driver (nvidia-smi), CUDA runtime (torch.version.cuda), torch, CuPy, numpy, Python, OS and the free/total device memory at the time of the record
physics_configuration.matrix: docs/PLATFORM_MATRIX.md, one row per platform; hardware cells are copied from the record file or read 'not recorded'
unrecorded_platforms: rtx5880-ada-win11-remote: partial facts exist in earlier measurement records but no platform record; the row stays 'not recorded' until scripts/platform_report.py is run on that machine

reference_method: the record file written by scripts/platform_report.py on the machine itself; the matrix test cross-checks every table cell against that file and rejects a row whose cells are not backed by a record

observables.name: record_fields
observables.definition: record_version, recorded_at, os, python, torch, cupy, cuda_runtime, torch_cuda_available, driver, gpus (name, compute_capability, total and free memory) present in a fresh report

observables.name: matrix_consistency
observables.definition: every hardware cell of a recorded row equals the record; every cell of an unrecorded row reads 'not recorded'; every record file has a row

observables.name: local_gpu_recorded
observables.definition: the GPU torch reports on the test host has a record file

acceptance_limits.report: the report exits 0 and contains every listed field; with CUDA available it lists at least one GPU with a d.d compute capability and 0 <= free <= total memory
acceptance_limits.matrix: no matrix row carries a value without a record file; at least one row is recorded; the RTX 5880 row is 'not recorded' until a record exists

applicable_scope: G4-01 on the local RTX 3060 host (rtx3060-win11-lab): the platform report runs and the matrix lists that platform from its record; the RTX 5880 Ada row is not recorded and not verified
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent

null_reasons.observed_metrics: no observed-metrics file was supplied; the JUnit pass/fail record is the only measurement
null_reasons.package_or_wheel_sha256: no distribution file was supplied; the evidence applies to the source tree at source_commit
